quotes.text: If previous captures didn’t include these fields, you can’t add them in later captures.
Pass in an updated `amount_details` hash that is consistent with the capture amount during Capture.
Pass in an updated `amount_details` hash that is consistent with the total authorized amount after the increment.
For card payments, Stripe doesn’t send mismatched line item data to card networks.
To populate tax information with the surcharge, use `amount_details[tax][total_tax_amount]` instead of `amount_details[line_item][tax][total_tax_amount]`.

old_evidence.text: Don’t create a separate line item for the surcharge.
the line items won’t correctly add up to the amount exclusive of the surcharge amount, and the request will 400.

findings: Both captures cover amount_details on a manually captured PaymentIntent. Request if_available where the example calls for multicapture, overcapture, incremental authorization or partial authorization. Payment-method support governs availability, and amount_details.line_items requires expansion to appear in the response. The multi-capture section explicitly excludes Klarna and PayPal (old 14-21, 413-417, 660-666, 912-918, new 15-22, 338-344, 531-537, 724-730).

At first capture, add amount_details and/or its line items if absent or include or explicitly unset either when supplied at creation. The general subsequent-capture prose says to keep individually retained fields and cannot introduce fields absent in prior captures. Amounts for discount, tax and shipping sum and line items aggregate. Postal codes may be omitted but cannot change if supplied. An incomplete nonfinal capture remains requires_capture; an explicit final capture or default final capture can transition to succeeded. The special partial-capture finish example passes zero and final_capture=true after the earlier capture, omits amount_details and line_items from the final request, and retains first-capture line items in its response (old 136-142, 231-239, 282-286, 346-362, new 107-113, 182-190, 213-217, 277-289).

Overcapture increases the capture up to maximum_amount_capturable, with amount_details matching the actual capture. Incremental authorization calls increment_authorization up to the payment-method limit, with amount_details matching the new total authorized amount, and the example remains requires_capture with zero amount received (old 540-544, 789-793 and 851-905, new 437-441, 630-634 and 663-717).

Partial authorization can produce amount_details_amount_mismatch when the old items no longer match the smaller approved total. The merchant can reconcile amount_details at capture, clearing the error and allowing Stripe to send card line data to the networks. The unreconciled case can still succeed at capture, but Stripe withholds mismatched card data and the transaction loses eligibility for L2/L3 savings. Network transmission is one prerequisite, not an assertion of actual savings (old 964-1016, 1042-1089, 1104-1147, new 756-808, 821-868, 876-919).

Wiki root index line 7 leads to Stripe index 563-569 and 713-718. Source 49-57 links the Payment Line Items concept, main source and Surcharge concept. Payment Line Items concept 57-103 reciprocates and carries the scenario definitions. Surcharge concept 23-25 and 50-59 covers surcharge state and compatibility and routes to the separately scoped surcharge guide.
substantive_changes: November 7 adds an explicit surcharge-plus-tax instruction to use top-level amount_details[tax][total_tax_amount] instead of line-level tax. The May 11 good example already populated top-level tax without stating the rule. The literal new prose uses singular line_item in its negative illustration, while actual example request arrays use line_items. Keep the semantic top-level-versus-line-level instruction without repurposing the negative spelling as a schema definition (old 1153-1178, new 925-946).

Node examples are rendered in curl, select a PaymentMethod without explicitly listing payment_method_types, add a sample return_url on confirmed creation and substitute placeholders in two capture examples. The incorrect surcharge example drops May's public-preview SDK comment with the SDK sample. These example and navigation changes establish no new API version, eligibility or live payment behavior (old 22-81, 1018-1039, 1091-1101, 1155-1214 and 1282-1347, new 23-52, 810-818, 870-873, 927-958 and 1026-1059).

answers.Q1: The November 7 capture at https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-line-items/flexible-payment-scenarios describes merchant use of amount_details on a PaymentIntent, including manual capture and if_available requests subject to method support. Multicapture excludes Klarna and PayPal, permits adding data at first capture, and describes general later-capture continuity for previously supplied fields, with no adding fields that prior captures omitted. The initial nonfinal partial capture can stay requires_capture and the explicit or default final capture can complete it. In the specific zero-amount example, the final request sets final_capture=true and omits amount_details and line_items even though the earlier capture sent them. The example response retains first-capture line items. Both captures present this prose/example tension (old raw lines 236-239 and old raw lines 346-362, new raw lines 187-190 and new raw lines 277-289). Stripe aggregates items and sums amounts across captures. Overcapture updates details to match the larger capture within its ceiling, while an increment updates details to match the larger authorized total without capturing it. A partial-authorization mismatch can be corrected at capture to enable card-network data transmission or remain when capture succeeds without sending mismatched data. A surcharge is included in the amount and specified separately, with top-level tax. The May mechanics match apart from the new explicit tax instruction (old raw lines 14-21, old raw lines 231-286, old raw lines 540-544, old raw lines 789-793 and old raw lines 964-1155, compared with new raw lines 15-22, new raw lines 182-217, new raw lines 437-441, new raw lines 630-634 and new raw lines 756-927). source-stripe-payment-line-items-flexible.md summarizes the scenarios but needs the tax qualification, field continuity, and capture/authorization ceilings.
answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-line-items/flexible-payment-scenarios, source-stripe-payment-line-items-flexible.md needs a source update. The substantive November 7 clarification directs top-level tax when using a surcharge, while the May 11 example already used top-level tax (old raw lines 1153-1178 versus new raw lines 925-946). Preserve surcharge-inclusive PaymentIntent amount, distinct surcharge field, and the example’s 400 when surcharge is also a line item (old raw lines 1280-1282 and new raw lines 1024-1026). Node-to-curl, example return URL and payment method selection, and the updated surcharge link are presentation or navigation. The dropped public-preview SDK note is historical example context (old raw lines 1284-1290 and new raw lines 1028-1034). Both dates preserve the general continuity rule and the distinct zero-amount final request omitting amount_details and line_items while the example response retains first-capture items (old raw lines 236-239 and old raw lines 346-362, new raw lines 187-190 and new raw lines 277-289). Treat the zero-amount example as scoped to its illustrated finalization. Existing missing late-add and ceiling checks are baseline findings, and sample object inconsistencies do not define behavior. Keep the Payment Line Items reciprocal source link, Surcharge concept route and May raw provenance.
